SC-2025-S1240.title: Boykin Spaniel Society
SC-2025-S1240.summary: A SENATE RESOLUTION TO RECOGNIZE AND HONOR THE BOYKIN SPANIEL SOCIETY FOR ITS DEDICATED EFFORTS IN PRESERVING AND PROMOTING THE BOYKIN SPANIEL BREED.
SC-2025-S1240.summarySource: South Carolina legislature, description (via Open States)
SC-2025-S1240.aiSummary: The Senate adopted a resolution to recognize and honor the Boykin Spaniel Society for its work to preserve and promote the Boykin Spaniel breed. It is a formal statement of thanks, not a law that changes state rules.

SC-2025-H5813.title: Community Investment Fund
SC-2025-H5813.summary: A BILL TO AMEND THE SOUTH CAROLINA CODE OF LAWS BY ADDING ARTICLE 7 TO CHAPTER 11, TITLE 11 ENTITLED "SOUTH CAROLINA COMMUNITY INVESTMENT FUND" SO AS TO CREATE THE FUND, TO SPECIFY THE CONDITIONS UNDER WHICH THE FUND MAY BE APPROPRIATED, TO ESTABLISH A PER-DISTRICT ALLOCATION FORMULA, AND TO PROVIDE FOR ADMINISTRATION, TRANSPARENCY, AND ACCOUNTABILITY REQUIREMENTS.
SC-2025-H5813.summarySource: South Carolina legislature, description (via Open States)

actions.text: Referred to Committee on Ways and Means

SC-2025-H5813.aiSummary: The bill would create the South Carolina Community Investment Fund. It would set rules for when money in the fund could be spent, use a per-district formula to divide funds, and add rules for how the fund is run, tracked, and reported. It would affect how state money is allocated to districts.

SC-2025-H5806.title: Pastor Sammie D. Simmons Day in SC
SC-2025-H5806.summary: A HOUSE RESOLUTION TO CELEBRATE PASTOR SAMMIE D. SIMMONS ON THE OCCASION OF HIS BIRTHDAY, TO RECOGNIZE AUGUST 30, 2026, AS "SAMMIE D. SIMMONS DAY" IN SOUTH CAROLINA, AND TO HONOR HIM FOR HIS UNWAVERING DEDICATION, VISIONARY LEADERSHIP, AND STEADFAST COMMITMENT TO ADVANCING THE KINGDOM OF GOD.
SC-2025-H5806.summarySource: South Carolina legislature, description (via Open States)
SC-2025-H5806.aiSummary: This resolution was adopted and recognizes August 30, 2026, as "Sammie D. Simmons Day" in South Carolina. It celebrates Pastor Sammie D. Simmons on his birthday and honors his leadership and service.

SC-2025-H5799.title: Harold Waynick sympathy
SC-2025-H5799.summary: A HOUSE RESOLUTION TO EXPRESS THE PROFOUND SORROW OF THE MEMBERS OF THE SOUTH CAROLINA HOUSE OF REPRESENTATIVES UPON THE PASSING OF HAROLD RAYMOND WAYNICK JR. OF SUMTER COUNTY AND TO EXTEND THEIR DEEPEST SYMPATHY TO HIS LARGE AND LOVING FAMILY AND HIS MANY FRIENDS.
SC-2025-H5799.summarySource: South Carolina legislature, description (via Open States)
SC-2025-H5799.aiSummary: A House resolution that expresses sorrow over the death of Harold Raymond Waynick Jr. of Sumter County and extends sympathy to his family and friends.

SC-2025-S586.title: Kershaw County Transportation Committee
SC-2025-S586.summary: AN ACT TO AMEND ACT 172 OF 1995, RELATING TO THE KERSHAW COUNTY TRANSPORTATION COMMITTEE, SO AS TO PROVIDE THAT EACH MEMBER OF THE KERSHAW COUNTY TRANSPORTATION COMMITTEE SHALL RECEIVE NINETY DOLLARS FOR EACH MEETING AT WHICH HE IS IN ATTENDANCE AND THAT THE CHAIRMAN SHALL RECEIVE ONE HUNDRED SEVENTY-FIVE DOLLARS, AND TO PROVIDE THAT SUCH PAYMENTS SHALL NOT OCCUR MORE THAN EIGHTEEN TIMES EACH FISCAL YEAR. - RATIFIED TITLE
SC-2025-S586.summarySource: South Carolina legislature, description (via Open States)

actions.text: Read third time and sent to House
Introduced, read first time, placed on local & uncontested calendar

SC-2025-S586.aiSummary: The act changes pay for members of the Kershaw County Transportation Committee. Each member would get $90 for each meeting they attend, and the chair would get $175. These payments would be limited to 18 times each fiscal year.

SC-2025-H5127.title: Capital Reserve Fund, appropriations
SC-2025-H5127.summary: A JOINT RESOLUTION TO APPROPRIATE MONIES FROM THE CAPITAL RESERVE FUND FOR FISCAL YEAR 2025-2026, AND TO ALLOW UNEXPENDED FUNDS APPROPRIATED TO BE CARRIED FORWARD TO SUCCEEDING FISCAL YEARS AND EXPENDED FOR THE SAME PURPOSES. - RATIFIED TITLE
SC-2025-H5127.summarySource: South Carolina legislature, description (via Open States)

actions.text: Effective date See Act for Effective Date
Unanimous consent for third reading on next legislative day
Read third time and sent to Senate
Special order, set for immediately following second reading of H. 5126
Introduced, read first time, placed on calendar without reference

SC-2025-H5127.aiSummary: This joint resolution would set aside money from South Carolina’s Capital Reserve Fund for fiscal year 2025-2026. It would also let any unused money carry over into later fiscal years and be spent for the same purposes. It became law in 2026.

SC-2025-S1226.title: St. Philip's Episcopal Church
SC-2025-S1226.summary: A SENATE RESOLUTION TO CONGRATULATE ST. PHILIP'S CHURCH IN CHARLESTON FOR ITS SIGNIFICANT, HISTORIC CONTRIBUTIONS TO THE FOUNDING OF THE PALMETTO STATE AND THE NATION.
SC-2025-S1226.summarySource: South Carolina legislature, description (via Open States)
SC-2025-S1226.aiSummary: The resolution congratulates St. Philip's Church in Charleston for its historic role in the founding of South Carolina and the United States. It was introduced and adopted by the Senate.

SC-2025-S1219.title: Southside High School Soccer
SC-2025-S1219.summary: A SENATE RESOLUTION TO CONGRATULATE THE SOUTHSIDE HIGH SCHOOL BOYS SOCCER TEAM, COACHES, AND SCHOOL OFFICIALS ON AN OUTSTANDING SEASON AND TO HONOR THEM FOR WINNING THE SOUTH CAROLINA CLASS AAAA BOYS SOCCER STATE CHAMPIONSHIP.
SC-2025-S1219.summarySource: South Carolina legislature, description (via Open States)
SC-2025-S1219.aiSummary: A Senate resolution would congratulate the Southside High School boys soccer team, coaches, and school officials for an outstanding season. It also honors them for winning the South Carolina Class AAAA boys soccer state championship, and it was adopted.

SC-2025-H5792.title: Charles Black sympathy

SC-2025-H5792.summarySource: South Carolina legislature, description (via Open States)
SC-2025-H5792.aiSummary: Lawmakers adopted a resolution expressing sorrow over the death of Charles Ernest "Chuck" Black Jr. of Marlboro County. It also extends sympathy to his family and friends.

SC-2025-H5778.title: Hon. Henry F. Saamoi, Executive Governor, Central Bank of Liberia
SC-2025-H5778.summary: A HOUSE RESOLUTION TO CONGRATULATE THE HONORABLE HENRY F. SAAMOI, EXECUTIVE GOVERNOR OF THE CENTRAL BANK OF LIBERIA, FOR HIS OUTSTANDING LEADERSHIP, DISTINGUISHED PUBLIC SERVICE, AND TRANSFORMATIVE CONTRIBUTIONS TO THE DEVELOPMENT AND MODERNIZATION OF LIBERIA'S FINANCIAL SYSTEM.
SC-2025-H5778.summarySource: South Carolina legislature, description (via Open States)
SC-2025-H5778.aiSummary: A House resolution congratulates Henry F. Saamoi, the executive governor of Liberia’s central bank, for his leadership, public service, and work to modernize Liberia’s financial system. It was introduced and adopted.

SC-2025-H5764.title: Goree Smith sympathy
SC-2025-H5764.summary: A HOUSE RESOLUTION TO EXPRESS THE PROFOUND SORROW OF THE MEMBERS OF THE SOUTH CAROLINA HOUSE OF REPRESENTATIVES UPON THE PASSING OF FRANKLIN GREGORY "GOREE" SMITH OF CALHOUN COUNTY AND TO EXTEND THEIR DEEPEST SYMPATHY TO HIS LARGE AND LOVING FAMILY AND HIS MANY FRIENDS.

SC-2025-H5764.aiSummary: The House resolution would express sorrow over the death of Franklin Gregory "Goree" Smith of Calhoun County and extend sympathy to his family and friends. It was introduced and adopted.

SC-2025-H5757.title: Walnut Grove Baptist Church Bicentennial
SC-2025-H5757.summary: A HOUSE RESOLUTION TO CELEBRATE THE HISTORIC TWO HUNDREDTH ANNIVERSARY OF WALNUT GROVE BAPTIST CHURCH, AND TO COMMEND THE CHURCH FOR TWO CENTURIES OF SERVICE TO THE GREENWOOD COUNTY COMMUNITY AND THE STATE OF SOUTH CAROLINA.
SC-2025-H5757.summarySource: South Carolina legislature, description (via Open States)
SC-2025-H5757.aiSummary: The resolution celebrates the 200th anniversary of Walnut Grove Baptist Church and commends it for two centuries of service to Greenwood County and South Carolina. It was introduced and adopted.
